t: With the Screen Controller you can power nearby $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/screen)screens$(/l). Using the 'Scan' button in the GUI you can connect to all screens in a 32x32x32 radius.$(br2)$(5)Infusing$() this machine will increase this range
使用屏幕控制器，你可为附近的$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/screen)屏幕$(/l)供电。在GUI中点击“扫描”按钮，即可连接半径32×32×32范围内的所有屏幕。$(br2)$(5)注魔$()该机器可扩大此作用范围。
Place the controller within range, supply FE, and press Scan. Re-scan after adding, removing, or moving screens.
将控制器放置于有效范围内，为其供应FE，并点击“扫描”。在增删或移动屏幕后，请重新扫描。
The default scan area is 32x32x32 blocks around the controller. $(5)Infusing$() the controller increases this range.
默认扫描区域为控制器周围32×32×32格的空间。$(5)注魔$()控制器可扩大此范围。
